page.layout: One column of chapter-list lines under the title "INDEX CAPITUM."; page numbers at the right end of each line; catchword "CAP" at the lower right; signature "* 3" at the foot left.

main_text.head: INDEX CAPITUM.
main_text.l: Cap. X. Quid statuendum de duello utilitatis publicæ gratiâ suscepto? | p. 87.
Cap. XI. Duella privata ab hostibus oblata, num accipienda? | p. 97.
Cap. XII. Utrùm patrem patriæ proditorem liceat occidere? | p. 103[?].
Cap. XIII. De duellis seriis extra judicia gloriæ causâ susceptis. | p. 117.
Cap. XIV. Duellum serium ostentationis gratiâ intum[?], num licitum? | p. 122.
Cap. XV. Utrùm duella ad defensionem sui adhibita, licita sint? | p. 131.
Cap. XVI. An si provocans interfecerit provocatum justæ defensionis beneficio usus esse censeatur, aut vice versâ? | p. 142.
Cap. XVII. Utrùm æqualitas armorum sit necessaria? | p. 146.
Cap. XVIII. Utrùm insultatus ab insultante primum ictum excipere teneatur, utrùm verò eundem antevertere possit? | p. 152.
Cap. XIX. Defensio necessaria utrùm licita adversus Magistratum? | p. 162.
Cap. XX. Utrùm eum liceat occidere, qui aliquem aggreditur animo tantùm mutilandi? | p. 168.

page.notes: Lines XII and XIV: the page numbers and the word "intum" are doubtful in the scan (the type is blurred and the ink is broken); "intum" is probably "initum". The "152." of Cap. XVIII sits on its own line below the text, and is kept on that line. The faint watermark at the lower right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
